captions.detailed: This 3D model is a customizable word pen consisting of a long, rounded cylindrical body and a matching protective cap. The main body of the pen features embossed block text spelling out "Pentastic" integrated directly along its length, with circular helper tabs at both ends to assist with print bed adhesion. The cap has a hollowed-out profile designed to slide snugly over the tapered tip of the pen, featuring a flat-sided clip running along its outer edge.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable word pen with an integrated cap in OpenSCAD. The script should allow users to adjust the embossed text, pen thickness, inner ink cartridge dimensions, and toggle helper tabs for easier 3D printing.
captions.factory: The script uses three main modules: 'wordpen', 'pen', and 'lid'. The pen body is constructed using rotated cylinders and cubes to create a comfortable rounded grip, while the embossed text is generated by extruding 2D polygons from a custom polyfont library. The lid module uses translated cylinders and cubes combined with a 'difference' operation to hollow out the inner cavity for the pen tip. Helper tabs are created using thin cylinders with a height of 0.15mm.
